Max HP: ~51      Will: +           AC: +          EV: ++

Threat: High    Class: Undead    Size: Medium    Int: Mindless  Regen: None

You have about 70% to hit with your +0 hand axe and 62% to hit with your headbutt.
It has about 68% to hit you.

Attack  Max Damage

It has a 100% chance to notice you each turn.
It is immune to torment; and resistant to miasma and drowning.
It is incapable of using stairs.
